name: Elevator Neighbour
source:
On a rainy day, after coming home from a long day at work, you meet your next-door neighbor on the elevator. Everything should be like any other day, there is no reason for anything strange to happen… and yet.

[From [url=https://corrocerous.itch.io/elevator-neighbour]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
下雨天，结束一天的工作回到家，你在电梯里遇见了隔壁邻居。一切都应该像平常一样，没有理由发生任何奇怪的事情……但是。

[来自[url=https://corrocerous.itch.io/elevator-neighbour]Itch.io[/url]]
